title: Input Telemetry (fixed)
tag_line: Live throttle, brake, clutch and steering graph for the HUD
message:
Adds a HUD app that draws your throttle, brake and clutch on a rolling graph, with three level bars for clutch, brake and gas and a grey steering trace.

How to use: open the HUD apps editor, add "Input Telemetry (fixed)" and place the panel. Values appear as soon as a vehicle is spawned.

This version publishes its own inputTelemetryFixed stream from a vehicle extension, so it does not depend on the shared electrics channel, and missing channels no longer throw errors.
